ios.desc:
your friends' chats, with superpowers.

every chat on bonds, with your best friend or with the whole group, gets an AI friend. a little unhinged, always on your side. it laughs at your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, gets everyone talking and helps you pull things off together.

and it creates things for you, right in the chat:

• working out? it creates a streak app, logs who went and roasts whoever skipped
• trip coming up? it creates the countdown, the plan and the packing list, and reminds everyone what to bring
• game night? it creates the game and keeps score
• worst photo of the night? it turns it into a sticker for the whole chat
• someone's birthday? it writes the song and sings it
• can't decide where to eat? it makes the poll and settles it

any crazy idea you come up with, just ask. everything lives inside the chat and updates for everyone. nothing to download.

IT CARES FOR YOU
it remembers what matters to your people, reminds you about plans, misses you when you're gone and pushes you to be better together.

A REAL MESSENGER
texts, photos, voice notes, calls, stickers, reactions and search. one on one or in groups.

MADE FOR YOUR PEOPLE, NOT AN AUDIENCE
no feeds. no followers. no ads. just the people who matter.

bonds is free. bring your people.

say hi: hello@bonds.chat
